title: G-Designer: Architecting Multi-agent Communication Topologies via Graph Neural Networks
authors: Guibin Zhang; Yanwei Yue; Xiangguo Sun; Guancheng Wan; Miao Yu; Junfeng Fang; Kun Wang; Tianlong Chen; Dawei Cheng
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent systems use hand-crafted or fixed communication topologies (chain/star/tree/complete graph) that are neither task-adaptive nor token-efficient, and are fragile to adversarial agents. The paper asks how to automatically design a task-aware, sparse, robust inter-agent communication topology per query.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM multi-agent 系統採用人工設計或固定的通訊 topology(chain/star/tree/complete graph),既無法隨任務調適,亦不具 token 效率,且對 adversarial agent 相當脆弱。本文探討如何針對每一 query,自動設計出具任務感知能力、稀疏且穩健的 agent 間通訊 topology。

key_innovation.en: A variational graph auto-encoder (VGAE) encodes agent nodes plus a task-specific virtual node (the encoded query) and decodes a customized directed communication topology per query, trained end-to-end with a policy-gradient task-utility loss plus a nuclear-norm sparsity regularizer so graph complexity scales with task difficulty.
key_innovation.zh: 本文提出一套 variational graph auto-encoder(VGAE):其編碼 agent 節點以及一個任務專屬的 virtual node(即編碼後的 query),並針對每一 query 解碼出量身訂製的有向通訊 topology。整體以 end-to-end 方式訓練,採用 policy-gradient 的任務效用損失,並加入 nuclear-norm 稀疏正則項,使圖的複雜度隨任務難度而縮放。

baselines_compared: Vanilla, CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, PHP, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Random Graph

key_improvements.en: Best average on the 6-benchmark harness (MMLU 84.50%); up to 95.33% token reduction on HumanEval.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測組平均最佳(MMLU 84.50%);HumanEval token 最多減少 95.33%。

decision_mechanism: Graph neural generator (GNN/VAE), Differentiable mask / pruning, Policy gradient / REINFORCE
backbone_models: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (text encoder for node features, D=384)
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Default N=5 gpt-4 agents collaborating over K=3 dialogue rounds on a per-query directed communication graph; each agent node has attributes (base LLM, role, state, plugins) and a task-specific virtual node (encoded query) is bidirectionally linked to all agents as an information sink. Single-domain: the VGAE is trained separately per benchmark (only 40 queries each). Tasks span general reasoning, math, and code generation.
agent_scenario.zh: 預設為 N=5 個 gpt-4 agents,在每一 query 專屬的有向通訊圖上,經 K=3 輪對話進行協作;每一 agent 節點具備屬性(base LLM、角色、狀態、plugins),而一個任務專屬的 virtual node(編碼後的 query)則與所有 agent 雙向連結,作為資訊匯集點(information sink)。單領域設定:VGAE 針對每一 benchmark 分別訓練(每項僅 40 個 query)。任務涵蓋一般推理、數學與程式碼生成。
